notes.title: HACK.BAK Out Now!
notes.notes: [h1]HACK.BAK is now available[/h1][p]Find the commands, traverse the network, and get the key to your precious data.[/p][p][/p][p]When I started making this a little over a year ago, I wasn't sure I'd be able to stick with it and release on Steam, but here I am, doing just that.  Thank you to all my friends who helped test the game and my wife for writing the text for many of the extra files you'll find on your path.  An especially big thanks to Captain Lucian for making the music.[/p][p][/p][p]If you enjoy this little game of mine, I hope you can share it with someone else who does too.[/p][p][/p][p]-David Huish[/p]

notes.title: Steam Deck Support
notes.notes: [p]HACK.BAK was designed with Steam Deck support in mind.  The native resolution for the game is 1280x800.  For best results in handheld mode, keep the game Fullscreen and set the Steam Deck's Maximum Game Resolution ([i]Settings -> Display -> Maximum Game Resolution) [/i]to Default or Native.[/p]
